records.jp: 想いを分けて、ってリフナビは言ってたけど……<CR>具体的にどうすればいいんだろう？
records.en_original: ReSource said we should share our emotions with her, but what does that actually mean?
records.en_auxiliary: ReSource said we should share our emotions with her, but what does that actually mean?
records.en: ReSource said to share our feelings with her...<CR>but what exactly are we supposed to do?

records.jp: 今、きららの精神は疲れて冷えきっている状態
records.en_original: Kirara's spirit is exhausted and rapidly cooling.
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara's spirit is exhausted and rapidly cooling.
records.en: Kirara's spirit is exhausted and completely chilled.

records.jp: その精神に再び熱を帯びさせるには、<CR>カッと体が熱くなるような材料が必要
records.en_original: To reignite it, we need to give her something that will cause her body to flare up.
records.en_auxiliary: To reignite it, we need to give her something that will cause her body to flare up.
records.en: To warm that spirit once more,<CR>we need material that will make the body flush with heat.

records.jp: 例えば――
records.en_original: For example...
records.en_auxiliary: For example...
records.en: For example...

records.jp: 「恥ずかしい想い」とか
records.en_original: A concoction of embarrassing memories would work.
records.en_auxiliary: A concoction of embarrassing memories would work.
records.en: Embarrassing feelings, for example.

records.jp: それって……
records.en_original: You mean...
records.en_auxiliary: You mean...
records.en: You mean...

records.jp: ココロトープに行って、恥ずかしい記憶を<CR>みんなの前で掘り起こせってこと？
records.en_original: We need to go to the Heartscape and dig up our embarrassing memories in front of everyone?
records.en_auxiliary: We need to go to the Heartscape and dig up our embarrassing memories in front of everyone?
records.en: You mean we have to go into the Heartscape and dig up<CR>embarrassing memories in front of everyone?

records.jp: そういうこと
records.en_original: Exactly.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly.
records.en: Exactly.

records.jp: ええ～……
records.en_original: Whaaaat...
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaaat...
records.en: Whaaaat...

records.jp: 何ためらってんの！<CR>きららが苦しんでるんだよ！
records.en_original: What are we waiting for?! Kirara needs our help!
records.en_auxiliary: What are we waiting for?! Kirara needs our help!
records.en: Why are you hesitating?!<CR>Kirara is suffering!

records.jp: そりゃ、あなたは記憶が戻ってないから<CR>何のためらいもないでしょうけど……
records.en_original: That's easy for you to say, seeing as you haven't gotten your memories back.
records.en_auxiliary: That's easy for you to say, seeing as you haven't gotten your memories back.
records.en: That's easy for you to say. You haven't recovered your memories,<CR>so of course you don't have anything to hesitate over...

records.jp: ……じゃ、じゃあ……私から行く！
records.en_original: ...I-I'll go first!
records.en_auxiliary: ...I-I'll go first!
records.en: ...I-I'll go first!

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Really?!
records.en_auxiliary: Really?!
records.en: Really?!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん！？
records.en_original: Ao, are you sure?!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, are you sure?!
records.en: Ao-chan, are you sure?!

records.jp: 正直、みんなの前で話すとか……<CR>どんな羞恥プレイ？　って感じだけど
records.en_original: To be honest, there are no words to describe how embarrassing this is, but...
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, there are no words to describe how embarrassing this is, but...
records.en: Honestly, talking about it in front of everyone...<CR>It sounds like some kind of public humiliation.

records.jp: でも……それがきららさんのためになるなら！<CR>私、頑張る……
records.en_original: It's for Kirara's sake, so I'll do my best!
records.en_auxiliary: It's for Kirara's sake, so I'll do my best!
records.en: But... if it will help Kirara-san,<CR>I will do my best...

records.jp: 愛央……あんた最高にかっこいいよ
records.en_original: Ao... You're so awesome.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... You're so awesome.
records.en: Ao... You're so awesome.

records.jp: ……えー、これは私が中学生の頃の話です
records.en_original: Whew. Okay, this is from when I was in middle school.
records.en_auxiliary: Whew. Okay, this is from when I was in middle school.
records.en: Um... This is a story from when I was in middle school.

records.jp: その頃の私は厨二病まっさかりで、<CR>授業中に人目を盗んでは禁断の書……
records.en_original: I was going through a bit of a goth phase, and I had this book that I secretly wrote in class.
records.en_auxiliary: I was going through a bit of a goth phase, and I had this book that I secretly wrote in class.
records.en: At the time, I was deep in my chuunibyou phase,<CR>secretly writing a forbidden tome during class...

records.jp: ま、いわゆる黒歴史ノートを作成していました
records.en_original: I called it the Forbidden Tome.
records.en_auxiliary: I called it the Forbidden Tome.
records.en: In other words, I was creating what you might call a 'dark-history notebook.'

records.jp: 黒歴史ノートって何でしょうか
records.en_original: The Forbidden Tome? What does that mean?
records.en_auxiliary: The Forbidden Tome? What does that mean?
records.en: What is a dark-history notebook?

records.jp: さぁ……
records.en_original: Beats me...
records.en_auxiliary: Beats me...
records.en: Beats me...

records.jp: 見られたくないものってことはわかるけど
records.en_original: Well with a name like that, it's definitely not something she'd want anyone to see...
records.en_auxiliary: Well with a name like that, it's definitely not something she'd want anyone to see...
records.en: I can tell it's something she doesn't want anyone to see, but...

records.jp: これもう既に恥ずかしい話じゃない？
records.en_original: Isn't admitting that embarrassing enough?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't admitting that embarrassing enough?
records.en: Isn't admitting that embarrassing enough?

records.jp: （あ、ヤバい。思い出すうちに<CR>どんどん恥ずかしくなってきた……！）
records.en_original: (Ack... The more I think about it, the more embarrassed I feel...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ack... The more I think about it, the more embarrassed I feel...)
records.en: (Oh no. The more I remember,<CR>the more embarrassing this becomes...!)

records.jp: （さっさと話して終わらせよう）
records.en_original: (Let's wrap this up quickly...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Let's wrap this up quickly...)
records.en: (Let's wrap this up quickly...)

records.jp: ある日、移動教室の授業でも書いていたら<CR>そのまま置き忘れてしまいました
records.en_original: I was writing in it in class one day, but on the way to my next class I realized I'd left it behind.
records.en_auxiliary: I was writing in it in class one day, but on the way to my next class I realized I'd left it behind.
records.en: One day, I was writing in it during a class held in another room,<CR>and accidentally left it behind.

records.jp: 慌てて取りに戻ると……
records.en_original: I ran back to the classroom, and...
records.en_auxiliary: I ran back to the classroom, and...
records.en: I ran back to the classroom, and...

records.jp: おい、お前これ見ろよ
records.en_original: Whoa, dude. Check this out.
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, dude. Check this out.
records.en: Hey, look at this.

records.jp: 「禁断の書」？　なんだそれ
records.en_original: "Forbidden Tome"? The hell is that?
records.en_auxiliary: "Forbidden Tome"? The hell is that?
records.en: A 'Forbidden Tome'? What is that?

records.jp: 多分前のクラスの奴の忘れ物。<CR>表紙に名前なかったから中見たら……
records.en_original: Someone must've left it behind. There's no name on it, so let's take a look...
records.en_auxiliary: Someone must've left it behind. There's no name on it, so let's take a look...
records.en: Someone from the previous class must have left it.<CR>There is no name on the cover, so I looked inside...

records.jp: 「我が真名は“月影”。<CR>我が照らすのは地下世界の暗黒史」……
records.en_original: "My true name is Moon Shadow. These pages hold the forbidden, untold histories of the Underworld."
records.en_auxiliary: "My true name is Moon Shadow. These pages hold the forbidden, untold histories of the Underworld."
records.en: 'My true name is Moon Shadow.<CR>What I illuminate is the dark history of the underworld'...

records.jp: 「血塗られた聖剣」……<CR>「邪眼の処刑人」……
records.en_original: "The holy blade, splattered with blood"... "The prisoner, cursed with an evil eye"...
records.en_auxiliary: "The holy blade, splattered with blood"... "The prisoner, cursed with an evil eye"...
records.en: 'The bloodstained holy sword'...<CR>'The executioner with the evil eye'...

records.jp: 「堕天使」って書いて「アンジュ・デシュ」……<CR>ぷぷっ、読めるわけねえだろ
records.en_original: What's this, "ange déchu"? Hah, do they think using French makes it sound cool?
records.en_auxiliary: What's this, "ange déchu"? Hah, do they think using French makes it sound cool?
records.en: It says 'fallen angel' but reads 'ange déchu'...<CR>Pfft, who could possibly read it that way?

records.jp: コイツやっば。<CR>俺なんか身体がカユくなってきた
records.en_original: This is so cringe! Whoever wrote this is messed up!
records.en_auxiliary: This is so cringe! Whoever wrote this is messed up!
records.en: This person is unreal.<CR>I'm starting to itch all over.

records.jp: もちろん持ち主だと言い出せるはずもなく……<CR>そのまま私は中学校を卒業しました
records.en_original: Of course I couldn't say it was mine. I graduated middle school without telling a soul.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course I couldn't say it was mine. I graduated middle school without telling a soul.
records.en: Of course, I could not possibly admit it was mine...<CR>and I graduated from middle school without ever doing so.

records.jp: 今でもそのノートは母校のどこかに<CR>封印されているとかいないとか……
records.en_original: And the Forbidden Tome is still sealed away somewhere inside that school...
records.en_auxiliary: And the Forbidden Tome is still sealed away somewhere inside that school...
records.en: To this day, that notebook may or may not remain sealed<CR>somewhere inside my old school...

records.jp: 以上！
records.en_original: The end!
records.en_auxiliary: The end!
records.en: The end!

records.jp: 感動しました
records.en_original: What a moving tale.
records.en_auxiliary: What a moving tale.
records.en: What a moving tale.

records.jp: 見直した
records.en_original: I underestimated you, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: I underestimated you, Hoshizaki.
records.en: I have gained new respect for you.

records.jp: そ、そういう話ではないんだけど……
records.en_original: Th-this is not the response I was expecting...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-this is not the response I was expecting...
records.en: Th-this is not the response I was expecting...

records.jp: わたしたちも、愛央ちゃんを見習って<CR>恥ずかしい記憶を掘り起こさないとね
records.en_original: After that, I think we all have to share our own embarrassing stories.
records.en_auxiliary: After that, I think we all have to share our own embarrassing stories.
records.en: We need to follow Ao-chan's example<CR>and dig up our own embarrassing memories too.

records.jp: いやほんと、さすがだよ“月影”
records.en_original: That was awesome, Moon Shadow.
records.en_auxiliary: That was awesome, Moon Shadow.
records.en: As expected of you, 'Moon Shadow.'

records.en_original: Urk!!
records.en_auxiliary: Urk!!
records.en: Urk!!

records.jp: ……や、やっぱり、やめようかな<CR>
records.en_original: Maybe we should stop here...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we should stop here...
records.en: M-maybe I should call this off after all...<CR>

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Agreed...
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed...
records.en: Agreed...

records.jp: あっ、ちょっと！　みんな！<CR>逃げるなんて卑怯だぞ！
records.en_original: Hey, wait! You can't just run away! That's not fair!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, wait! You can't just run away! That's not fair!
records.en: Hey, wait! Everyone!<CR>Running away is not fair!

records.jp: 私だけこんな思いをするなんて許さない……
records.en_original: I won't allow myself to be the only one subjected to this pain...
records.en_auxiliary: I won't allow myself to be the only one subjected to this pain...
records.en: I won't allow myself to be the only one subjected to this pain...

records.jp: 一人残らず暴露させてやる……<CR>絶対にだ……
records.en_original: I will unearth all of your deepest, most embarrassing memories... I swear it.
records.en_auxiliary: I will unearth all of your deepest, most embarrassing memories... I swear it.
records.en: I will make every last one of you expose yours...<CR>I swear it...

records.jp: ひえー！
records.en_original: Aaaah!
records.en_auxiliary: Aaaah!
records.en: Aaaah!
